description: This file contains functions related to processing documentation files, including reading, parsing front matter, translating content and front matter, handling caches for translations, and writing translated files back to disk. The main function `processFile` orchestrates these operations for a given document, supporting internationalization (i18n) workflows.

classes.name: TMEntry
classes.description: Represents a translation memory entry containing cached translated segments along with metadata such as source path, text hash, timestamps, provider, and model.

classes.name: PiTranslator
classes.description: An external translator component interface used to perform translation tasks.

classes.name: TranslationMemory
classes.description: A collection or cache interface for storing and retrieving translation segments based on cache keys.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Main function to process a documentation file: reads, parses front matter, translates front matter and body content, updates cache, and writes the translated output.

methods.name: splitFrontMatter
methods.description: Splits the content into front matter and body based on YAML front matter delimiters.

methods.name: encodeFrontMatter
methods.description: Encodes front matter data back into a YAML-formatted string, including metadata for i18n.

methods.name: translateFrontMatter
methods.description: Translates specific front matter fields like title, subtitle, and read_when, using caching.

methods.name: translateSnippet
methods.description: Translates a small segment of text with caching to avoid duplicate translation requests.
